mapper.update: UPDATE pjt_approval_lines SET step_order = #{stepOrder}, sort_in_step = #{sortInStep}, line_type = #{lineType}, approver_id = #{approverId}, status = #{status}, active = #{active}, acted_at = #{actedAt}, comment = #{comment} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, u.name AS approver_name, u.email AS approver_email FROM pjt_approval_lines l LEFT JOIN pjt_users u ON u.id = l.approver_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
